resources.string: Connect this device to the AiSignX server at %1$s and show its content here? Only continue if you started this from the install page of your own server.
Could not start the pairing. Make a new install link in the admin and try again.
Enter the address of your AiSignX server, then press Test. Pair this screen in the admin under Displays after saving.
This address is not an AiSignX server
Enter an address such as 192.168.1.20:5000 (http or https, no path)
The server certificate is not trusted by this device
Server certificate changed. Check it below before trusting it again.
Plain http to a public address is not encrypted. Use https for servers outside your local network.
Use as Home app (recommended for signage boxes; starts the player after boot)
Press Test first. Saving needs a successful test.
Server forgotten. This screen will need to be paired again.
Open the AiSignX setup screen on this device?
Too many wrong PINs. Try again in %1$s.
This app is the Device Owner: Lock player keeps the screen in lock task with no Home, Recents or status bar.
That page is not available here; opened the main Settings page instead. If it closes at once, use the other pages above.
Android would not open that settings page. See the log.
Unlocked for %1$d more minutes; the lockdown comes back after that.
This erases ALL data on this tablet, including the app and its set-up. Afterwards the tablet must be provisioned again with a new QR code (Downloads > Set up an Android tablet).
Type RESET to erase this device
Not erased: the word did not match.
Android refused the factory reset. Press Collect logs on the web page (Displays > this screen) and look at the log, or use Remove Device Owner below and reset from Android Settings.
Android is erasing this device and will restart. This can take a minute.
Android did not start erasing. Use Remove Device Owner below, then Settings > General management > Reset > Factory data reset.
This device is not managed by AiSignX (no Device Owner), so the app cannot erase it. Use Android Settings > Reset instead.
To use this device normally again: untick "Use as Home app", press Save, then press the Home button. To start over, use Remove Device Owner below (then factory reset).
Device Owner removed. Lock player now uses screen pinning.
Android refused to remove Device Owner. See the log.
